name: Proposals - Create, approve, and convert proposals
description: Verifies the commercial proposal flow: creation with line items, PDF generation, approval workflow, and conversion to order

planSteps.description: Assert that proposals list loads with status columns (draft, sent, approved, rejected, converted)
Click 'New Proposal' and verify the creation form loads with sections: client info, line items, terms
Add line items: description, quantity, unit price, and verify the total auto-calculates correctly
Set proposal terms (validity period, payment terms) and save as draft
Assert that proposal is saved as 'draft' and the total matches expected calculation
Submit proposal for approval and verify status changes to 'sent'
Approve the proposal and verify status changes to 'approved' with option to convert to order
Click 'Generate PDF' and verify a PDF preview/download is available
